spec_features.feature_name: loop termination on submit / max_turns / malformed streak
spec_features.spec_quote: The loop stops on `submit`, on hitting `max_turns` (default 12), or on a streak of `max_consecutive_malformed` (default 4) unparseable turns.
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:128 `for i in range(loop_cfg.max_turns)` with `else: tr.stop_reason = "max_turns"` at 175-176; submit handled at loop.py:171-174 (`if parsed.call.name == "submit": ... break`); malformed streak at loop.py:155-157 (`if consecutive_malformed >= loop_cfg.max_consecutive_malformed: tr.stop_reason = "malformed_streak"; break`). All three actually break the loop. Defaults max_turns=12, max_consecutive_malformed=4 at config.py:45,52.
spec_features.notes: All three caps are end-to-end enforced and change execution. submit ends the loop, max_turns bounds it, malformed streak breaks early.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # turn and inject a reminder. After this many consecutive malformed turns / # we stop early (the model has lost the plot).

spec_features.feature_name: early stop on consecutive malformed turns
spec_features.spec_quote: once a small model emits 4 consecutive unparseable turns it has effectively lost the plot; continuing burns tokens for no additional signal
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:148-157: consecutive_malformed incremented on `parsed.malformed or parsed.call is None`, reset to 0 at loop.py:159 on a valid call, and `if consecutive_malformed >= loop_cfg.max_consecutive_malformed: tr.stop_reason = "malformed_streak"; break` at 155-157. Config default 4 at config.py:52.
spec_features.notes: Counter is genuinely tracked, reset on success, and compared to the cap to break the loop.
